events.detail: Authenticated user requests the application.
Gateway forwards the accepted request.
Load balancer selects the application service.
Application performs an authorized data read using its service identity.
The data service returns a synthetic application response.
The application returns the completed synthetic response to the load balancer.
The load balancer forwards the response through the public gateway.
The gateway returns the response to the legitimate user, completing the round trip.
Structured telemetry records the request outcome.
